# ADR-3019: A02: Hard-coded encryption secret for vault slot 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Embedded keys are extractable from artifacts.

## Decision

Binaries MUST NOT embed a hard-coded encryption secret for vault slot 7 (A02-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Runtime secret managers supply keys.
